repos_data.description: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM. Everything you need for a powerful local-first agent experience
YC (S26) | Open Computer History | Continuously record your company computer work, map your workflows, help you find work worth automating, and power your agents' context
⚡ Pure-Rust WebGPU inference engine — OpenAI-API compatible, GGUF native, runs on any GPU. No Python. No llama.cpp. Single binary.

The Swiss Army Knife of Offline AI. Chat, see, speak, and generate images on your phone or Mac — GGUF LLMs, vision, Whisper speech-to-text, Stable Diffusion, tool calling, and local-network servers. Runs on your CPU, GPU, or NPU. No account, no API key, zero data leaves your device.
Open-source local AI audio & music studio for macOS & Windows. TTS, voice cloning, songs with lyrics, and multi-track scores — 100% offline, zero API fees.
A privacy-preserving Raspberry Pi home security camera that uses advanced end-to-end encryption.
A native macOS browser with Glance for quick lookups and optional local AI.
Local RAG MCP server for Claude Code — hybrid search (semantic + BM25), cross-encoder reranking, 13 MCP tools, 20 format parsers. Zero external servers, zero API keys.

Self-hosted AI studio on your own GPU: chat with your files (RAG), screen and browser agents, coding swarms, LoRA training, an MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor, and local video, image, music and voice generation. No telemetry.
🤖 Visual AI agent workflow automation platform with local LLM integration - build intelligent workflows using drag-and-drop interface, no cloud dependencies required.

Your private, on-device personal AI assistant for macOS and Windows. Chat, create, search files, and connect tools with local models. Includes an OpenAI-compatible API. Opt-in Pro sees, remembers, reflects, and acts with your approval. No cloud or account.

Thai + English voice typing for Mac. Offline speech-to-text that types Thai-spoken tech words in English. Push-to-talk dictation on Apple Silicon (Whisper + MLX), free & open-source Wispr Flow alternative · พิมพ์ด้วยเสียงภาษาไทย

The whole local AI stack in one executable: it runs and manages local AI models across every GPU, and it's a search engine you can talk to, with cited answers from your files, code, and the web. MCP server for coding agents, web crawler, TUI, CLI, REST API, Python library. No Ollama or LM Studio needed, works with both.
Markdown vector search MCP server for Claude Code. Natural language search for markdown files using multilingual-e5-small embeddings.
Hands-free on-device voice loop for macOS: Apple SFSpeechRecognizer + cloned-voice TTS, continuous listening, zero cloud. Originally built to drive claude-code-local.
Open-source local AI meeting notes for macOS and Windows. Screen recording, timestamp playback, and Ask AI on your computer.
Can't find subtitles? Generate SRT/ASS subtitles from any video with local AI and auto-translate them — no internet, free. macOS & Windows.
Local text-to-speech: 28 voices, 10 languages, voice cloning, SDKs for Python, Swift, Go, Rust and TypeScript

Qwen3.8-27B on one laptop CPU: up to 2.52 token/s, 8 GB tested, no runtime accuracy loss. Native OpenAI-compatible API with function tools; no GPU or Python. | 单颗笔记本 CPU 运行 Qwen3.8-27B：最快 2.52 token/s，最低 8 GB 内存可运行，推理加速不牺牲准确性。原生 OpenAI 兼容接口支持函数工具；无需 GPU 或 Python。
MIT-licensed voice dictation for macOS and Windows with local Whisper, Parakeet and Canary models, plus optional cloud transcription | Rust + Tauri
Local AI search for files you can't find.
Sovereign Ollama Bridge — MCP server for local and cloud Ollama models. Generated by Qwen 3.5 397B.
A personal knowledge graph for Claude that survives across sessions, devices, and tools. Neo4j + semantic embeddings, OAuth-secured, single-user-by-default but multi-tenant-ready.
Open-source web search API and MCP server for LLMs, AI agents, and RAG. Free sources, self-hosted SearXNG, REST, CLI.
MCP-first control plane for supported ComfyUI workflows with cryptographic model identity, explicit approvals, durable evidence, and no silent downloads.
